newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN TOURISTS PREFER SOUTH TO NORTH.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN TOURISTS PREFER SOUTH TO NORTH.

text.p: When it comes to holiday preferences Belgians forget their country's linguistic make-up.
Only 150,000 Belgians holidayed with their Dutch neighbours in 1996. Thirteen times as many Belgians went to France.

With the 1997 holiday season almost half way through, the Belgian National Statistics Institute said on Friday France was by far the prefered destination in 1996, attracting some 1.95 million tourists from its northern neighbour.
Last year 5.2 million Belgians took some 7.2 million holidays; 78.3 percent of these abroad.
One in 15 never left the country: 1.56 million vacationers stayed in Belgium itself.
The majority of holiday-makers organised their holidays themselves (61.2 percent), 32.4 percent booked through a travel agent and 6.3 percent went on group organized holidays.
